name: Urinary Stones and Obstruction: ESWL, URS and PCNL

reference.source: Campbell-Walsh-Wein Urology 12th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Supersaturated urine crystallises obstructing colicking while relaxed ureters pass small stones spontaneously; shock waves cavitate fragmenting draining steinstrasse, and tracts dilate clearing staghorns bloodlessly.
